column4: Western Sahara is disputed (Morocco administers most of it; the Sahrawi Republic claims it): Wikidata gives its item no capital, and none is given here
Sucre is the constitutional capital and La Paz the seat of government (Wikidata gives both; Wikipedia infobox: "Sucre (constitutional and judicial), La Paz (executive and legislative)")
three capitals, executive (Pretoria), legislative (Cape Town) and judicial (Bloemfontein): Wikidata, mledoze and Wikipedia agree
Mbabane is the administrative capital and Lobamba the royal and legislative one (Wikidata gives both; Wikipedia agrees)
Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte is the legislative capital and Colombo the executive and judicial one (Wikidata gives both; Wikipedia agrees). The two are next to each other
Sanaa is the capital by the constitution, held by the Houthis since 2014; Aden is the internationally recognised government's temporary capital (Wikidata gives both; Wikipedia agrees)
East Jerusalem is the proclaimed capital, Ramallah where the government sits (Wikidata gives both; Wikipedia agrees)
